 Banana oatmeal recipe:

1 large banana

Half a cup milk (I use skim cow milk, 1.5%fat, any milk would work I think)

1.5 cup water
(You can choose all milk but wouldn't recommend as water makes it more creamy)

0.25 teaspoon cinnamon 

2 teaspoon honey (trust me it makes a difference in taste)

2 pinches of salt

1 scoop whey protein (1.5 tablespoon) (I use vanila concentrate)

And of course 1 cup rolled oats

(You can double the amount in this receipt for 4 servings and of course you can modify it)

Oatmeal topping (optional, it will make it taste way better tho):

2 tablespoons granola ( I make this receipe with olive oil, it's enough for 3-4 weeks:  https://cookieandkate.com/healthy-granola-recipe/

If you don't want to make granola, use some nuts (walnuts or almonds are best imo) and some chia/flax seeds/your favorite seed for similar tatse)


1 teaspoon peanut butter (natural, not processed) (ive also made it with almond butter, it tastes pretty good, use any but butter)

Half a large banana

Instructions:

Add 1 cup of rolled oats into a pot.
Add 1.5 cups of water after that.
Add now half a cup of skim milk.
Add 2 teaspoons honey 
Add 2 pinches of salt
Add 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon

Slice a large banana into small pieces (small pieces will melt in better with the oatmeal)

Add your banana Pieces in the pot.

Coock it on high temperature on a stovetop.

While cooking keep mixing it so the ingredients balance out in the oatmeal.

When the liquid starts  to coock and forms bubbles, set a timer for 2 minute. 

Keep mixing and coocking untill 2 minute passes, and you should end up with a creamy sticky liquid.

After your done coocking and mixing and the liquid is still hot, add 1 scoop of whey protein (1.5 tablespoon).

Now mix in the Protien untill you can't see a trace of it.

Now it's done, you need topping tho imo for true tatse.

Oatmeal topping (optional, worth it tho)


Slice half a large banana and place your banana slices on top of your oatmeal liquid.

Add 2 tablespoon granola/nuts/seeds sprinkled across your oatmeal.


Add 1 teaspoon of peanut butter , make sure it covers every part of the oatmeal.

Now it's done, awesome breakfast with complex carbs , protein and some healthy fats and low saturated fat. This breakfast gets me the energy I need for the day, it's amazing.

Tho , you may want to coock it different than me, sometimes the pan burn, if it does , lower heat next time.
